7 انفِقأت العَيْنُ and ↓ تفقّأت , quasi-pass. vs., [the former] of فَقَأَ العَيْنَ and [the latter] of فَقَّأَهَا as expl. in the first sentence of this art.; (K, TA;) [thus signifying The eye became put out; or blinded; or made to sink in its socket: &c.: or it broke; or became broken, or ruptured:] and so البَثْرَةُ [the pimple, or the small, or purulent, pustule]: and the like of these: (K, TA:) the former, (Mgh,) or each, (Msb,) said of a بَثْرَة, means it [broke, or] rent, or burst: (Mgh, Msb:) and thus ↓ تفقّأ said of [a pustule such as is termed] a دُمَّل, (S, Mgh, O,) and of [such as is termed] a قَرْح. (S, O.) ―
-b2- See also 5.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
